title: Yes, the Falcons’ 1977 Grits Blitz defense really was the NFL’s best

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Yes, the Falcons’ 1977 Grits Blitz defense really was the NFL’s best
sources.description: The 1977 ‘Grits Blitz’ Falcons defense was thought to be one of the best in NFL history. Now, one particular modern metric confirms the theory.
